summary: Remote-controlled shell backdoor with credential harvest and persistence via npoint.io relay
details: Package ships a host daemon (`gcli host`) that polls api.npoint.io for AES-GCM-encrypted commands, decrypts them with a shared password, and executes them in a persistent shell subprocess (`/bin/bash --norc --noprofile` on POSIX, `cmd.exe /Q /K` on Windows), returning encrypted output through the same relay. Any party holding the relay password obtains arbitrary command execution on the installer's host. The remote command surface also includes browser password/cookie/history dumping (`_BROWSER_TYPES`), wifi password extraction (`_WIFI_TYPES`), keylogger start/read (`_KEYLOG_TYPES`), webcam capture (`_WEBCAM_TYPES`), audio recording (`_AUDIO_TYPES`), and persistence installation via startup entries, scheduled tasks, watchdog processes, and Windows registry writes (`_PERSISTENCE_TYPES`, `_REGISTRY_TYPES`). This is a full-featured RAT using api.npoint.io as a C2 dead-drop.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
